name: Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Cement Grey'
story_html: The Air Jordan 3 Retro 'Cement Grey' is built with white tumbled leather on the upper, featuring dark grey elephant print on the eyestay and forefoot and heel overlay. Atop the tongue, an embroidered crimson Jumpman delivers a pop of color. A second Jumpman logo adorns the molded heel tab. Finished in grey and off-white tones, the polyurethane midsole packs an encapsulated Air-sole unit in the forefoot and an exposed Air bag in the heel.
